title: Paanch Claude skills jo kam log jaante hain
content:
Yeh paanch powerful Claude skills hain.
Inhe mushkil se koi jaanta hai.

Number ek, Chief of Staff.
Claude ko ek bada goal do.
Woh peeche AI agents ki team ko kaam baantta hai, aur kaam karwa leta hai.

Number do, Anatomy.
Koi technical topic do, jisme atak rahe ho.
Woh uski samajh ko ek aisa model bana deta hai, jise click karke khol sakte ho.

Number teen, Teach.
Claude ko batao, kya seekhna hai.
Woh lessons banata hai.
Cheat sheet banata hai.
Progress yaad rakhta hai.
Jahan chhoda tha, wahan se aage badhte ho.

Number chaar, Marketing Psychology.
Isme 50 se zyada psychology ke niyam hain.
Jaise loss aversion, aur pricing strategies.
Marketing behtar karne ke liye.

Number paanch, Last 30 Days.
Ek topic chuno.
Yeh Reddit, X, YouTube, aur TikTok pe dekhta hai.
Pichhle mahine log kya keh rahe the.

Paanchon ke links aur setup chahiye, to follow karo.
Comment karo, skills.
Main bhej dunga.
